connector.name: Redash MCP
connector.registryDescription: Connect Redash to Claude -- query data, manage dashboards, and run SQL with natural language.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package redash-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the seob717 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: REDASH_API_KEY
env.description: Your Redash user API key (found in Settings > Account)

env.name: REDASH_SAFETY_MODE
env.description: SQL safety mode: 'strict' blocks risky queries, 'warn' (default) returns warnings, 'off' disables guards (not recommended).

env.name: REDASH_SAFETY_DISABLE_PII
env.description: Set to 'true' to disable the PII column guard. Not recommended.

env.name: REDASH_SAFETY_DISABLE_COST
env.description: Set to 'true' to disable the query cost guard. Not recommended.
